newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks seen mixed to weak at open.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks seen mixed to weak at open.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to open mixed to lower in a followthrough of yesterday's high tech-driven selloff.

In addition to residual weakness from yesterday and weak bonds after the release of weekly jobless claims, the market will also see caution on the part of investors ahead of tomorrow's eagerly-awaited January employment report.

"The market's reversal yesterday indicates that we are in for a rather soft day today," said Peter Cardillo, director of research at Wesfalia Investments. "Nervousness in the high tech group will persist."

"If we get another selloff in the tech sector today, we will hit a near-term bottom and it will be time to buy," Cardillo said. Some techs, including Intel Corp and Microsoft Corp, were higher in overnight trading in London.
Cardillo said that investors may well be cautious ahead of January payrolls and the unemployment rate due out ahead of the start of trading Friday.
"The key report is tomorrow," he said. "I'm looking for the numbers to be a bit lower than expected. The economy is slowing and the tight labor market is beginning to show signs of weakening."
